notes: Square, low-resolution (1280 px) phone photo of a green metal manga bookcase in a Japanese shop, taken from the left at a slight angle, fluorescent light, soft focus, no glare. The main case holds English-language editions (VIZ, Kodansha, Yen Press); the case at the far left holds Japanese-language manga and light novels whose spines are too small to read. Series are numbered volumes with no volume names (One Piece 67-80, Naruto 1-8 and 72, Dragon Ball 2-7, Dragon Ball Z 2-4, One-Punch Man 1-9, My Hero Academia 2-6, Yu-Gi-Oh! 2-4, Slam Dunk 1-4, 10 and 31, Knights of the Zodiac 17, 28, 29, D.Gray-man 1-2, Black Butler I-III, Sailor Moon 1-11), so each series is labelled once by the series title as printed rather than one entry per number; the Ghibli titles are film comics. Sailor Moon spines print 'Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon' with Sailor Moon as the large text. Corrections to the draft: 'Kuroko no Basket' is not on the shelf (those spines are Rurouni Kenshin and Knights of the Zodiac); 'Howl's Moving Castle' could not be found among the blue Ghibli spines. Left out: the Japanese-language case on the left, the shelf cut at the top of the frame, the Kiki's Delivery Service and Ponyo film comics (thin blue spines, not resolvable at this size), the bottom shelf beyond Death Note and 20th Century Boys, and several yellow and pink spines between Hunter x Hunter and Totoro. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 84), verified by an agent.
